instruction: Write an XDP program that implements 5-tuple canonical ECMP load balancing for TCP/UDP traffic. Calculate a verifier-safe hash over (saddr, daddr, sport, dport, protocol), and forward packet across 4 backend interfaces using `bpf_redirect(target_ifindex, 0)` where target_ifindex is `10 + (hash % 4)`. Pass non-IP traffic with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Parse Ethernet, IPv4 headers and verify TCP or UDP protocol
Account for variable IPv4 IHL and parse L4 ports
Extract 5-tuple: source IP, destination IP, source port, destination port, protocol
Return bpf_redirect(backend_ifindex, 0) for matching L4 traffic, XDP_PASS for others
Entry point SEC("xdp") and GPL license

tests.name: tcp_ecmp_redirect
tests.description: TCP flow must be redirected to calculated backend interface

tests.name: udp_ecmp_redirect
tests.description: UDP flow must be redirected to calculated backend interface

tests.name: icmp_pass
tests.description: ICMP traffic without L4 ports must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: truncated_packet_pass
tests.description: Truncated packet must return XDP_PASS safely
